text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous
races alongside Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let's go to a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the hot springs.
Now then, please get ready.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Explain...? I simply thought right now was the ideal time to visit a hot spring, though...
choice_data_list: No, that's not it— why me?
No, that's not it— why me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that is much simpler to explain.
It is because I want to go with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
From our debut to this very day,
we've been running nonstop, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So now that things have settled down a bit,
I want to take you to a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Hot springs are wonderful. They rest both body and soul,
and above all, they feel absolutely fantastic."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wanted to savor that comfort together with you, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Did you not like it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's good...
Then it's settled.
choice_data_list: You're going to use that hot springs trip voucher, huh?
You're going to use that hot springs trip voucher, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...?
What do you mean by "that"...?
choice_data_list: What I won in the raffle...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
The lottery from the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Friends... hmm, tough choice.
A friend I'd want to go to a hot spring with...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, could you hold onto
that ticket for a while?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I had completely forgotten. But...
Leaving it with you was definitely the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Because in the end, the one I wanted to go with...
was you."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's take a relaxing soak in the hot springs.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
...That bath felt great!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The temperature and the feel of the water are perfect.
That hot spring was so soothing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I was able to come with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it seems I was the only one getting carried away.
Were you able to get enough rest?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness...
Hehe, that warmed my heart even more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now then, as for what's next...
choice_data_list: It's the dinner you were looking forward to.
It's the dinner you were looking forward to, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
T-There is that, too... but before that,
there was one more thing I was looking forward to.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Would you like to take a short walk outside?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wah... What a beautiful starry sky.
It's really... yeah, beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer...
Well, seems like you're already enjoying yourself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I heard the stars here are beautiful,
so I was really looking forward to taking a walk with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Together with you, I've run with my eyes locked straight ahead, without even time to look at the sky..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet, it's strange.
Even now, we're still looking in the same direction."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that will never change...
I want to keep seeing the same scenery as you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I was hoping that would be the case.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I speak a little slowly,
so... could you walk at an easy pace with me?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
Afterward, walking beneath the starry sky... I chatted with Oguri Cap for as long as time allowed.

It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable
bond between myself and Oguri Cap...
